## 🔍 Type of Change

Please mark the options that are relevant:

- [ ] **fix:** A bug fix (non-breaking change which resolves an issue)
- [ ] **feat:** A new feature (non-breaking change adding functionality)
- [ ] **refactor:** Code overhaul without behavioral or interface changes
- [ ] **perf:** Code change that improves runtime performance
- [ ] **style:** Formatting, CSS polish, or visual alignment without logic changes
- [ ] **docs:** Documentation updates or guides
- [ ] **test:** Adding or correcting automated tests
- [ ] **chore:** Maintenance, dependencies, or configuration changes
- [ ] **BREAKING CHANGE:** Fix or feature that alters public API or storage contracts
